priorityList.notes: Combustion on cooldown, as a straight burst cooldown rather than gated on Improved Scorch stacks. Fix round 3: the engine only creates the Improved Scorch debuff aura (12873) from the raid's own debuff toggle, never from this mage's Scorch casts, so a stack gate can never resolve true here (engine follow-up: model the mage's own Scorch applying the debuff). Talent-gated and unregistered under this bare smoke build regardless (see smokeBuildWarnings) -- this line documents intent, the same shape Arcane Power and Presence of Mind use in mage-arcane.
Fire Blast on cooldown as a free extra nuke that does not compete with Fireball for a global.

Fireball is the primary filler. Fix round 3: Scorch is no longer cast at all -- with no working Improved Scorch stack gate available (see above), an unconditional Scorch line would simply win every global ahead of Fireball, the same defect fix round 1 tried and failed to remove.
